name: @pwa-kit/app-update
description: pwa-kit: the PWA update state machine (startAppUpdates: look for a new build on start, on return to the foreground and every 30 minutes; offer a waiting build; applyUpdate takes it over and reloads once, or anyway after 10 s), with an optional quiet take-over of a build with nothing new, and the React hook useUpdateState.
